titulo: 'I want to spark new ideas': Architect Ma Yansong on designing the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art
cuerpo: Last month, film producer George Lucas opened his long-awaited Museum of Narrative Art for many legions of fans of Star Wars memorabilia and visual storytelling. Ma Yansong, the Chinese architect who designed the futuristic looking building, says he hopes it "sparks curiosity and new ideas."
